narrative: 用它来揭示那些没人能站着看足够久才能察觉的规律：天气、施工、车流、一株植物、一座城市的清空与重新填满。
人们往往不再是主角，而变成了一个系统。摄影机通常是锁定的，这样唯一的运动就只有时间本身。
对于一场喜剧性的降速表演拍摄，或让静止的主角处于飞速人群之中（那是另一套配方），它都是错误的工具。如果摄影机必须在数小时压缩的同时沿街移动，你想要的其实是移动延时（Hyperlapse）。
不要把太阳一动不动、只有人群加速的画面，称作完整的昼夜延时。
how: 规划好拍摄间隔、总时长、曝光和稳定性。默认使用锁定的云台。
对于昼夜转换，要渐变曝光，让窗户在天光消失时逐渐亮起。如果要呈现完整的一天，太阳和阴影必须移动。
提示词：Prompt: Time-lapse of [Subject] or the world around them, hours in seconds, shadows sweeping, crowds as smoke.
when: 用它来展示天气、施工，或从一个稳定视点呈现夜晚变成清晨的过程。不要用它只是让演员的表演变快。
vs: 延时摄影不是快动作（Fast Motion）——后者是加速一段连续拍摄的镜头。移动延时（Hyperlapse）则是在间隔拍摄的基础上，加入了明显的摄影机空间移动。
延时风光（Timelapse Landscape）专攻天气与阴影。延时人像（Timelapse Human）则在飞速的人群中冻结一个意志。
延时化妆（Timelapse Glam）对着一张保持不变的脸，以间隔采样的方式记录服装的变化。
examples_film: 《失衡生活》（Koyaanisqatsi）把车流、人群和城市周期变成了宏观规律。《天地玄黄》（Baraka）通过改变时间尺度来组织城市与仪式。
两者都是间隔采样的语法，而不是可以照搬的画面。
mistakes: 最常见的误用邻居是快动作。破绽是：太阳一动不动，而行人却拖出虚影，或建筑物在变形。
修正方法：写明用几秒钟表现数小时、稳定的摄影机，以及连续移动的阴影。如果只有人在加速，你并没有真正展现出一整天。

faq.q: 电影中的延时摄影是什么？
faq.a: 延时摄影是间隔摄影：以较大的时间间隔拍摄帧，再连续播放，让缓慢的过程被压缩进一段短暂的银幕时间。

faq.q: 延时摄影（Time-Lapse）与快动作（Fast Motion）的区别
faq.a: 快动作是加速一段连续拍摄的录像。延时摄影则是在帧与帧之间跳过大段时间，这正是一整天、一次施工或一片天空能在几秒钟内播完的原因。

faq.q: 什么时候该用延时摄影？
faq.a: 当故事讲的是一个对实时来说太过缓慢的过程时：天气、施工、化作流动的人群、夜晚变成清晨。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写延时摄影的提示词？
faq.a: 写明用几秒钟表现数小时、扫过的阴影，以及稳定的视点。如果要呈现完整的一天，就要求太阳必须移动。不要只是让人群加速。

narrative: Use it to reveal a pattern no one can stand still long enough to see. Weather, construction, traffic, a plant, a city emptying and filling.
People often stop being protagonists and become a system. The camera is usually locked so the only motion is time.

It is the wrong tool for a comic undercrank of a performance, or for a still hero in a racing crowd (that is a different recipe). If the camera must walk the street while hours collapse, you wanted a hyperlapse.
Do not call a fast crowd under a stuck sun a full day-to-night lapse.
how: Plan interval, total duration, exposure, and stability. A locked head is the default.
For day-to-night, ramp exposure so windows light as the sky dies. The sun and shadows must travel if the claim is a full day.
Prompt: Time-lapse of [Subject] or the world around them, hours in seconds, shadows sweeping, crowds as smoke.
when: Use it to show weather, construction, or a night becoming morning from a stable viewpoint. Do not use it to make an actor's performance merely faster.
vs: Time-lapse is not Fast Motion, which accelerates a continuous take. Hyperlapse adds significant camera travel through space on top of the interval.
Timelapse Landscape is the weather-and-shadow specialty. Timelapse Human freezes one will inside a racing crowd.
Timelapse Glam interval-samples wardrobe on a held face.
examples_film: Koyaanisqatsi turns traffic, crowds, and urban cycles into large-scale patterns. Baraka organizes cities and ritual through altered temporal scales.
Both are grammar for interval sampling, not frames to copy.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is Fast Motion. The tell is smeared pedestrians under a sun that never moves, or architecture that morphs.
Fix: write hours in seconds, a stable camera, and continuous shadow travel. If only people race, you have not shown a day.

faq.a: Time-lapse is interval photography: widely spaced frames played continuously so slow processes occupy a short passage.
Fast motion speeds a continuous recording. Time-lapse skips long stretches between frames, which is how a day, a build, or a sky can play in seconds.
When the story is a process too slow for real time: weather, construction, crowds as flow, night becoming morning.

faq.q: How do I prompt Time-Lapse for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write hours in seconds, sweeping shadows, and a stable viewpoint. Require the sun to move if you claim a full day. Do not only speed a crowd.
